subject.title: [Bug]:  cron scheduled wake to main session is skipped (status=skipped, error="disabled"), so the main agent is never woken

question: Which linked PR should be the canonical landing path for the cron main-session wake behavior, and should cron-owned wakes bypass per-agent heartbeat scheduler omission when global heartbeats are enabled?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the open fixes overlap and change compatibility-sensitive heartbeat configuration semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent policy or merge path by itself.

options.title: Land the fuller direct-and-queued fix
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101584 as the preferred candidate if it gains real cron proof and maintainer acceptance for the cron override semantics.

options.title: Repair the narrower direct-run PR
options.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101977 to cover queued scheduler wakes and provide real cron proof before it can own the issue.

options.title: Keep per-agent omission authoritative
options.body: If omitted agents must remain suppressed for cron too, reject the bypass direction and keep the issue open for a different design.

recommendation.title: Land the fuller direct-and-queued fix
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101584 as the preferred candidate if it gains real cron proof and maintainer acceptance for the cron override semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision centers on per-agent heartbeat configuration semantics, which trace back to their heartbeat configuration work.
